policy.method: public web/search metadata and public pages only
policy.engagementRule: Only directly visible/verifiable engagement is canonical; secondary or absent values remain non-canonical/null.

candidates.title: US 10-year yield moves beyond 5% as global bond selloff rattles stocks
candidates.whyItMayWork: A clean 5% threshold hook connects rates, stocks and borrowing costs for US-stock audiences.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Fast-moving market numbers require timestamped re-checks and must not become investment advice.

candidates.title: MediaTek launches Dimensity 9600 Pro using TSMC 2nm technology
candidates.whyItMayWork: 2nm, on-device AI and Qualcomm competition make a compact phone-tech comparison card.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Performance claims need source attribution and independent benchmarks before stronger conclusions.

candidates.title: Workers debate whether R U OK? Day becomes a performative workplace ritual
candidates.whyItMayWork: Visible discussion and a familiar workplace ritual create a strong but low-intensity debate card.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Mental-health context needs respectful framing; avoid mocking people seeking help or generalizing one workplace thread.

candidates.title: Gamers debate September release crowding as publishers avoid GTA 6
candidates.whyItMayWork: A crowded release calendar creates a practical what-to-play/buy discussion with visible community debate.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: The thread predates this run and release dates can move; current schedules must be rechecked before production.
